narrative.overview: Bliss looks like it came out of the Marital Bliss box: a printed teal ground of halftone dots, a tomato band across the top, butter-cream card stock, and navy ink drawn around everything. It is flat print, not a table and not a dark card app. The old green-felt look is replaced, not extended.
keyCharacteristics: Halftone dots are the only texture
Every shape is outlined in ink, 3px on the outside
Depth is a hard ink lip under pressable things; no soft shadows
Chango for voice and numbers, Quicksand for everything you read
Kept and Done arrive as rotated mustard stamps

rules.name: The Ink Rule
rules.body: All outlines, shadows and text are navy ink (#2b2f45). Never black, never grey, never a tinted shadow.

rules.name: The Dot Rule
rules.body: A large flat area of teal, tomato or cream is dotted, never plain. Small things (tiles, buttons, stamps) stay flat.

rules.name: The State Is Mustard Rule
rules.body: Mustard marks a decision (kept, reward, done, commit). Do not spend it on decoration.

rules.name: The Tile Rule
rules.body: Every number that matters (pager, days/hours/minutes) is a letter tile, with its unit as plain bold text beside it. Do not set a number loose in running text.

rules.name: The One Shouter Rule
rules.body: Chango is for names, headings, numerals and the primary action. Running sentences are Quicksand.

rules.name: The Lip Rule
rules.body: The only shadow is a hard, zero-blur, straight-down ink lip, and only on things that can be pressed (plus the wordmark). Cards, stamps and tiles carry keylines, not shadows.

dos: Do outline every object in 3px navy ink (#2b2f45) and use no other line colour.
Do put every number in a cream letter tile with a tomato Chango numeral.
Do keep large flat fills dotted (teal ground, tomato band and card back, cream card stock), each with its own dot colour.
Do give every pressable thing the 4px hard ink lip and let it sink when pressed.
Do use mustard only for a decided state: kept, reward, done, commit.
Do keep card images at full strength; state is carried by a stamp, never by fading the ink.
Do honour reduced motion (animations and transitions collapse to near zero) and keep a 56px minimum height for thumb targets.
donts: Don't return to the green-felt, casino-table look or to a dark card app; the ground is teal print.
Don't use soft, blurred or tinted shadows; the only shadow is the zero-blur ink lip.
Don't set numbers as plain text in running copy.
Don't use black or grey; all ink is navy.
Don't set Chango for sentences; it is for names, headings, numerals and the primary action.
Don't put tomato on more than one band, one primary button and one card back at a time.
